title: Caucasian War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Caucasian War", at revision 1377773180, opens: "The Caucasian War or the Caucasus War was a 19th-century military conflict between the Russian Empire and various peoples of the North Caucasus who resisted subjugation during the Russian conquest of the Caucasus. It consisted of a series of military actions waged by the Russian Imperial Army and Cossack settlers against the native inhabitants such as the Adyghe, Abazins, Ubykhs, Chechens, Dagestanis as the Tsars sought to expand." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q382116, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1763–1864 invasion of the Caucasus by the Russian Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
